summary: First-pass MVP testing of Kanha Atelier luxury single-page e-commerce site. Tested 5 backend endpoints with pytest and 32 frontend UI/integration checks with Playwright against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All tests passed.

issues: The weaving <video> element renders but the actual video frames did not appear in the screenshot during testing — likely a slow asset load on the customer-assets CDN (the long .mp4 URL). The element + data-testid='craftsmanship-video' is correctly mounted in the DOM with the right src. Not blocking, just worth verifying visually in a real browser.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py: `logger` is referenced inside /api/geo (line 90) and /api/exchange-rate (line 119) but defined at the bottom of the file (line 159). At runtime this works because routes execute after import completes, but it is fragile and reads as a bug. Move `logging.basicConfig(...)` and `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` up before any route definitions.

backend/server.py uses synchronous `requests.get(...)` from inside async FastAPI route handlers (/api/geo, /api/exchange-rate). This blocks the event loop. Prefer `httpx.AsyncClient` (or `await asyncio.to_thread(requests.get, ...)`) for non-blocking IO. Low impact at this traffic level but should be fixed for production.

frontend/src/lib/currency.js: USD price computed by dividing INR price by live rate produces awkward sub-dollar amounts (e.g. KA-LUX-002 priced at ₹45,000 displays as $472.15 — fine, but KA-BGT-008 at ₹4,200 will display as ~$50.60 with cents). Consider rounding USD prices to whole dollars for the luxury-brand feel, or to nearest $5/$10.

frontend/src/App.js: `loading` state defaults to true and the LoadingScreen unconditionally calls `onDone` after 2.8s — works, but if `detectCurrency()` is still pending after the loading screen exits, the navbar briefly shows the placeholder '—' currency. Consider gating loading-screen dismissal on currency context resolution OR pre-rendering a sensible default earlier.
seed_data_creation: test_status_post_then_get inserts one row {client_name: 'TEST_kanha_pytest'} in MongoDB collection `status_checks`. Safe to leave; prefix is TEST_*
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: /api/health, /api/geo, /api/exchange-rate, /api/status (GET+POST) all green. Geo correctly returns US/USD for the private-IP browser-test environment. Exchange rate live from open.er-api.com returned ~95 USD→INR. Frontend: loading screen dismisses ~2.8s, navbar+currency chip ($ USD) shown, hero heading + 3 videos + pager dot click work, hero CTA scrolls to collections and WhatsApp CTA href contains wa.me/919369921454, all 8 product cards render with prices and per-product WhatsApp deep-links (verified for KA-LUX-002 contains name 'Persian Aubusson Floral' and id KA-LUX-002), tier filters luxury(2)/budget(1)/all(8) all correct, craftsmanship video element + 3 pillars present, contact-whatsapp-cta href correct, footer-instagram href points to kanha_enterprises_carpet. Re-use /app/backend/tests/test_kanha_backend.py for regression.
